claim.claim-text: 1. A fluid handling cassette for use in a medical infusion system, the cassette comprising:

2. The fluid handling cassette of claim 1, wherein the second fluid flowpath (202) is connected to a patient line cassette port (154) of the plurality of cassette ports, the patient line cassette port configured for connection to a patient line.

3. The fluid handling cassette of claim 1 or 2, wherein the first fluid flowpath (200) is connected to a drain line cassette port (152) and a heater line cassette port (150) of the plurality of cassette ports, the drain line cassette port configured for connection to a drain line, and the heater line cassette port configured for connection to a heater bag line.

4. The fluid handling cassette of any one of the preceding claims, further comprising a third group of valve wells (185), each valve well comprising a valve port (186) connecting the respective valve well to the second side of the body, and each valve well of the third group of valve wells configured for fluid communication with a solution line located at a second end of the body.
5. The fluid handling cassette of claim 4, wherein each valve well of the third group of valve wells (185) is connected to a lumen of a solution line spike (160) on the second end of the body.

6. The fluid handling cassette of claim 4 or 5, wherein the second fluid flowpath (202) is connected to the third group of valve wells (185) via the respective valve ports (186) of the third group of valve wells.

7. The fluid handling cassette of any one of the preceding claims, wherein the cassette comprises a first flexible membrane (15) attached to the first side of the body over the pump chambers (181) and the plurality of valve wells, wherein the first flexible membrane over the pump chambers is configured for moving fluid in the pump chambers, and the first flexible membrane over the plurality of valve wells is configured for selectively occluding the valve ports of the respective valve wells.

8. The fluid handling cassette of any one of the preceding claims, wherein the first and second fluid flowpaths (200, 202) comprise walls on the second side of the body, and wherein the cassette comprises a rigid or flexible sheet (16) attached to the second side of the body, wherein the sheet is configured to make sealing contact with the walls to form the first and second fluid flowpaths.
